subject: Activation choreography: owners, cadence, and jumpstart plan
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Summers <ava.summers@novaterra.com>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@novaterra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 13 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Activation choreography: owners, cadence, and jumpstart plan

Hi Ava / Tom —

Thanks for a constructive kickoff earlier today. Per our call, I’m sharing a concise jumpstart plan (attached: MAP-Novaterra-v1.xlsx) that lays out the first 8 weeks of work, named owners, and critical dependencies. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm go-live target (you mentioned Aug 10 tentative) — we need a firm date by June 20 to reserve Dedicated slots.
- SAML metadata + IdP contact for SSO testing (page 2 of MAP).
- Which environments can we access for staging (VPC peering vs. IP allowlist)?

Key owners (proposal):
- Redwood PM: Marissa Cole — overall delivery and scope decisions
- Solutions eng: Ben Carter — integration tasks, test plans, and cutover support
- Customer success: Soojin Lee — adoption cadence, training, and acceptance criteria

Milestones summary (excerpt):
1) Week 0 (Jun 14–20): SOW sign, staging access, high-level runbook agreed
2) Week 1–2: SSO bench + data ingestion smoke test
3) Week 3–5: Feature integration, throughput tuning, UAT
4) Week 6–8: Production cutover window, validation, and hypercare

I’ve also attached a lightweight integration checklist to speed discovery. Please review and mark any owner changes directly on the sheet (comments enabled). If the go-live moves earlier than Aug 10 we’ll need to accelerate the SSO and data onboarding tasks.

Next step: Ava, can you confirm which of the three SSO options you’ll use (Okta, Azure AD, or generic SAML) and who on your side will own IdP config? We’ll then lock the Week 0 runbook.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

Attachment: MAP-Novaterra-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet, 2 sheets)
Attachment: integration-checklist.csv (CSV, ~30 lines)
From: Ava Summers <ava.summers@novaterra.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Tom Briggs <tom.briggs@novaterra.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation choreography: owners, cadence, and jumpstart plan

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Quick answers below:

- Go-live: still aiming for Aug 10 but we need to finalize a compliance checklist with our Security Ops by June 22. I’ll escalate on our side.
- SSO: we’ll use Okta. IdP owner is Tom Briggs (cc’d).
- Staging: we can provide a VPC peering connection; I’ll share the network contact.

Tom — can you confirm the Okta admin and send SAML metadata to Ben by EOD Wednesday? If we can get SAML in the first sprint that would unblock UAT.

Ava
Director, Product Operations
Novaterra Analytics
ava.summers@novaterra.com | +1 617-555-2299

Tom / Ava —

Thanks — I’ll take ownership of the SAML integration tasks. To keep us nimble I propose the following immediate checklist (I’ve also added these as comments on the MAP sheet):

- Ben (Redwood) -> generate SP metadata and provide a test IdP endpoint by Jun 18
- Tom (Novaterra) -> share Okta metadata and add our SP to your dev org by Jun 19
- Network: exchange CIDR ranges or request peering; staging IPs required by Jun 18 for allowlist
- Data contract: small sample export of event payloads (anonymized) by Jun 22

I’ll schedule a 45-minute hands-on SSO session Wed Jun 17 10:00–10:45 PT unless you prefer a different slot. Please confirm.

Ben Carter

Quick note from CS:

- I’ll own the acceptance criteria doc and training schedule. Draft timeline here:
  • Training pilot for 6–8 superusers: Jul 19–23
  • Broader enablement waves: Jul 26–Aug 7
  • Cutover readiness review: Aug 5 (final acceptance signoff)

- Open risk: if UAT hits more than 3 critical defects, we’ll propose a 1-week slip and rebase the cutover window.

Marissa — I’ve added these milestones to the MAP and linked the training deck on Drive. I’ll run a 30-minute adoption alignment call next Tuesday (Jun 23) to review waves and pre-reqs.
